sourceCapture: Public web-reader capture of the current Rankings page. The page labels the dataset as Official Tencent data · Master+ CN · Updated 2026-11-07 · patch 7.3e.
statisticsAttribution: Wild Rift Core reports that these rankings are sourced from the official Tencent CN platform; TierListBase did not independently fetch Tencent.
tierAttribution: Role tiers are the current Wild Rift Core source-tier assessment, not Riot or Tencent official tiers.
trendCaveat: Only six spotlight movements are explicitly labeled as 7-day Master+ changes. The per-row table column is labelled “30 d”, so TierListBase does not reinterpret those row deltas as 7-day changes.
